notes.title: Update to 5.6: Now Support WMV Format Video Compression
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

iTop Screen Recorder 5.6 brings more improvements for a better game recording and editing experience, please see the list below for more details.


+ The video compression tool now supports the WMV format.
+ Audio from the microphone and speaker can now be saved separately during recording.
+ Optimized recording process to reduce the occasional record failures caused by GPU acceleration issues.
+ Improved audio capture workflow to proactively detect conflicts and guide users to solve the no-sound issue.
+ Fixed known bugs.

+ Audio from the microphone and speaker can now be saved separately during recording.

tags.bug: + Optimized recording process to reduce the occasional record failures caused by GPU acceleration issues.
+ Improved audio capture workflow to proactively detect conflicts and guide users to solve the no-sound issue.

notes.title: Update to 5.5: Supports MOV Files from Apple Devices
notes.content:
Hey guys!

We’ve just released our latest version iTop Screen Recorder 5.5 which helps you better record your gameplay as well as edit your videos with 4k UHD quality output.

Checkout Improvements:
+ Optimized encoding parameters to effectively reduce the recorded file size.
+ Improved the recording process to further reduce the chance of recording a black screen.
+ Improved Quick Editor to also support MOV files imported from Apple devices.
+ Fixed known bugs.

Plus, our Pro version is on Spring Sale—it's a win-win! Check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1621510/iTop_Screen_Recorder_PRO/

notes.title: Update to 5.3: Support Recording More Webcam Device
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

iTop Screen Recorder 5.3 brings more new features and improvements for a better game recording and editing experience, please see the list below for more details.


What's New:
+ Newly added Split in Quick Editor to support deleting any unwanted clips.
+ Newly supported setting the initial parameters when establishing a new project in Advanced Editor.
+ Newly supported customizing Video Quality to adjust the exported file size in Advanced Editor.
+ Newly supported running the record in console mode for easier integration with your ongoing work.
+ Improved Webcam recording to support more camera devices.
+ Optimized Unblur to greatly reduce disk space usage.
+ Improved Enhanced Mode for a better solution to the black screen issues in recorded files.
+ Fixed known bugs.

notes.title: Update to 5.2: Support Recording from any Device
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

iTop Screen Recorder 5.2 brings more new features and improvements for a better game recording and editing experience,  please see the list below for more details.


What's New:
+ New Device recording to record external device screens including mobile phones and tablets.
+ Unblur tool now supports unblurring videos and images to make the original blurry ones clearer.
+ Newly supported to select Time zone and enable Enhanced mode under Recording Scheduling.
+ Newly supported to Flip and Rotate in your Webcam recording.
+ Newly supported to crop under Quick Editor.
+ Fixed known bugs.

notes.title: Update Announcement (iTop Screen Recorder 4.1)
notes.content:
Hello, everyone,

We’ve just released our latest version of iTop Screen Recorder! Our brand new game recording mode will help you record your awesome gameplay more easily and smoothly! Get iTop Screen Recorder 4.1 NOW!

Checkout improvements:
+ Added Keystroke Visualizer to record high-quality lectures, webinars, online classes, etc.
+ Added Lock Window to record the selected window even when hidden or covered.
+ Added Noise Reduction to support filtering out environmental noise in real-time during recording.
+ Added Mute Microphone hotkey to mute your mic whenever you want.
+ Added two AI Tools: Text to Speech and Talking Head for more efficient and interesting recording.
+ Improved Game Recording to select the wanted games for recording easier.
+ Optimized UI for better user experience.
+ Fixed known bugs.
